# krateo-otel-collector (code repo) — LLM doc index

> krateo-otel-collector is the custom **OpenTelemetry Collector** distribution for Krateo
> ClickStack: the telemetry → ClickHouse ingestion path. It is built with the OTel Collector
> Builder (`builder-config.yaml`) from upstream contrib components plus one in-tree custom
> processor, `compositionresolver`, which stamps each Kubernetes-event log record with a
> `krateo.io/composition-id` attribute. This index is the agent entry point to the
> **internals & runtime** view (how the collector is built; what the processor does; the
> pipeline that flows to ClickHouse). The **deployment, CRD/config and observability-wiring**
> view lives in the chart repo `braghettos/krateo-clickstack-chart` `docs/` (the
> `otel-collector-deployment` chart).

## How to use this index (agents)

You are reading the docs for a SPECIFIC deployed version. Fetch every file below **at the tag
that matches the running build**, not `main`:

- **image version** = the otel-collector Deployment's container image tag
  (`ghcr.io/braghettos/krateo-otel-collector:<tag>`) → **THIS repo's** git tag. The image tag
  equals the chart's `appVersion`. Read this repo's docs at that **image-version** tag.
- **chart version** = `CompositionDefinition.spec.chart.version` for the clickstack chart →
  the `krateo-clickstack-chart` repo tag. Read the chart docs there.

If something isn't in the docs, read the source at that same tag — don't guess, and don't
trust `main` for a deployed older version.

## Start here

- [architecture.md](architecture.md): how the collector binary is assembled — the OCB
  `builder-config.yaml` component set, the `compositionresolver` processor's structure
  (factory/config/processor), where it sits in the pipeline, and what it stamps. Read first.

## Internals & runtime

- [behavior.md](behavior.md): the runtime receivers → processors → exporters pipeline, what
  flows to ClickHouse, and the composition-id enrichment contract consumed downstream by
  sse-proxy `/events`. The resolve/cache/eviction lifecycle traced at `file:line`.
- [gotchas.md](gotchas.md): runtime pitfalls grounded in config/code — in-cluster RBAC needs,
  the alpha stability level, log-only enrichment, negative-cache staleness, version pinning,
  and the OpAMP/supervisor relay-config trap.

## Reference (source of truth)

- `builder-config.yaml` — the OCB manifest: the exact receivers/processors/exporters/extensions
  (and versions) compiled into the binary.
- `compositionresolver/` — the custom processor: `factory.go` (type + defaults),
  `config.go` (typed config + `Validate`), `processor.go` (resolve + cache logic),
  `go.mod` (k8s client-go / collector pins).
- `Dockerfile` — the two-stage OCB build → distroless image.
- `README.md` — product overview + build/release signposts.
